card.name: The letters PH as an abbreviation
card.fires_on: The token PH, mostly as the abbreviation for pulmonary hypertension, and also at the start of names like PHESGO or PHAROS. It also fires on a few other name openings such as Fayette and FOP.

modes.label: PH for pulmonary hypertension

modes.label: PH starting a longer name
modes.description: PH as the opening piece of a drug or study name, or of an acronym.
modes.example: Verify the pregnancy status of females of reproductive potential prior to the initiation of<< PH>>ESGO.

modes.label: Other name openings
modes.description: The start or middle of a proper noun or condition acronym, such as a place or disease abbreviation.
modes.example: There is a relatively high background prevalence of psychiatric disorders in untreated patients with F<<OP>>.
